identity_note: Matched R1 RCM (brand now styled 'R1'), the Murray, UT revenue-cycle-management company at r1rcm.com, formerly Accretive Health and formerly NASDAQ: RCM. Sector (medical RCM) and website match the batch entry; no collision risk.

profile.name: R1 RCM (R1)
profile.description: Outsourced and technology-led revenue cycle management for US hospitals, health systems and physician groups, now built around its AI 'Phare OS' platform and R37 AI lab; says it serves ~1,000 providers including 95 of the top 100 US health systems.
profile.location: Murray, UT (Wikipedia / Yahoo Finance profile); 2026 press releases datelined Chicago; large offshore delivery footprint (India and elsewhere)
profile.founder: Founded as Accretive Health in 2003 by Mary Tolan and Michael Cline (renamed R1 RCM 2017). Current CEO Joe Flanagan (not a founder; CEO 2016-2023, CEO again since Nov 2024 take-private; quoted as CEO in Aug 2026 Humata release).
profile.funding_detail: Taken private by TowerBrook Capital Partners and Clayton, Dubilier & Rice; deal closed Nov 2024 at ~$8.9B ($14.30/share), delisted from NASDAQ. Khosla Ventures made an undisclosed investment in R1 (June 2025) to back the R37 AI lab.
profile.headcount: ~29,400 full-time (Yahoo Finance / GlobalData); Wikipedia gives ~30,000 (2023) and 27,200+ in body text. LinkedIn figure not retrieved.
profile.past_completed_deals: Humata Health (AI prior authorization; agreement announced Aug 18, 2026, close expected by end of Q3 2026, closing not confirmed); Phare Health (London AI inpatient coding; agreement Oct 2025, team folded into R37); Cloudmed (~$4.1B, 2022); VisitPay (~$300M, closed Jul 2021); SCI Solutions (closed Apr 2020); Cerner RevWorks business (2020).
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Revenue Cycle Operations (patient registration, coding), R37 AI/product engineering, Service Delivery (439 open roles) as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: Active acquirer of AI RCM tech · no corp dev seat open
verdict.detail: Two AI tuck-ins in a year (Phare Health, Humata Health); M&A is run by EVP Corp Dev & Strategy Dan Bise, with sponsors TowerBrook and CD&R behind him.
